detail: By-election triggered by the October 2024 resignation of Hugo Prevost (LFI). First round (12 Jan 2025): Louffok led with 28.33% (8,495 votes) and Galliard-Minier second with 26.57% (7,966 votes); abstention reached a record 64.14%. She won the run-off with 64.3%, returning the seat to the presidential camp.

result: Elected as substitute; became deputy in March 2020 when Véran joined the government
detail: Ran as Olivier Véran's substitute (LREM). She took up the deputy's seat in March 2020 after Véran was appointed Minister of Health, holding it until 2022.
